name: Reddish salmon
lede: Reddish salmon glosses Momo-iro, a Japanese traditional name that literally means peach-colored.

sections.title: A gloss for Momo-iro
sections.body:
The library files this hex under *Momo-iro* (桃色), whose kanji name the color of a peach, not a fish [1]. "Reddish salmon" is the English gloss chosen for the library so the color reads without the Japanese word, though the gloss describes the hue rather than translating the name [1]. The hex #F47983 is a screen approximation; no exact date or recipe for this shade is recorded in the sources consulted here [1].

Its nearest library neighbor is [[blush-pink]] [1]. The parent hue, [[salmon]], names the wider family this shade sits inside [1].

Other close matches in the library include [[light-coral]] and [[carnation]], both read as almost the same color [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: The automated archive tool used for this project could not compute a usable match count for this hex, so no painting-archive figures are given here [2]. The swatch should be read as a screen approximation only, not as evidence of how often the color appears in the archive [2].
